title: Çevre Kahramanları: Sıfır Atık Peşinde
author: Doğan Akdoğan
description: While Pelin and Kemal are enjoying summer vacation, Professor Dodo invites them on a new adventure. They travel back in time to save the future. Seeing that there was much less waste in the past, the Environmental Heroes begin working to restore Dream Forest to its former beauty.
